title: Choose the visual world for the new panel
question: The roll assigned The Kanban Post. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Kanban Post
options.lineage: Toyota withdrawal kanban and the heijunka levelling box
options.thesis: Every card on the floor is a sleeved kanban sitting in its station's pigeonhole.
materials: card stock in a vinyl sleeve
options.viewport: Floor sentence on top; below it the cabinet: one row per project, one column per station, each live card in its slot, held cards turned to their red side with the answer buttons; Needs you as a strip down the right.
options.risk: Seven stations get narrow on a phone; the cabinet must collapse to one strip per project.

raised.raise: Rank by weight and reversal: one small type scale, and what needs you is the screen's only reversed plate.
One station mark drawn the same at every size: cabinet header, card progress strip and index row.
Answering focuses: the card being answered lifts out of its slot and the rest of the cabinet dims.
Times sit right-aligned against the slot edge, like a timed tracklist: elapsed beside the span it runs against.
Flat committed fields: the cabinet is one ink field and the cards one cream stock, with no gradients, glows or grain.

options.label: The Traveler
options.lineage: machine-shop routing sheets, inspection stamps and red hold tags
options.thesis: Every card is a shop traveler: operations in order, each stamped by its inspector, a red hold tag when it stops.
options.viewport: One traveler per project stacked down the floor; operation rows 010–070 with stamps for passed gates; a hold tag pinned over the one that waits for you.
options.risk: The most familiar reading of a factory for this product: forms and stamps can drift into costume.

options.label: The Concourse Board
options.thesis: The floor as a departures board: one row per line, flaps cascading when a card changes station.
options.viewport: A board of rows, one per project: card, station, elapsed, cost, state lamp; the station column flips as the job advances; answers open beneath the row.
options.case: Fuses cleanly and feels alive; loses narrowly on audience identification — a transport artifact, not a factory.
options.risk: Reads as a novelty board if the flip is used beyond the one column that changes.

options.label: Timetable Slide Rack
options.lineage: 1971 pocket airline timetables on a light table
options.thesis: A raked rack of tinted slides at one single type size.
options.viewport: Projects as raked slides along a lit bed.
options.case: Fuses poorly: an 11° rake and one type size slow down a screen people scan for problems.
options.risk: Loses scanability on dense, live content.
options.kept: Rank carried by weight and reversal instead of size.

options.label: Bitmap Specimen
options.thesis: Coarse pixel letterforms at poster scale.
options.viewport: A pixel headline over dense columns.
options.case: Fuses poorly: operators do not identify with type specimens, and pixel display type fights live data.
options.risk: Becomes a type poster, not a working floor.
options.kept: One form repeated faithfully at every size.

options.label: Streaming Title Wall
options.thesis: Rows of tiles; the focused one grows and the wall dims.
options.viewport: Projects as rows of run tiles.
options.case: Fuses partly: good for browsing past runs, poor for reading every line's state at once.
options.kept: The focused item lifts and everything else steps back.

options.label: Mixtape J-card
options.thesis: Tracklists ruled in ballpoint and timed to the tape.
options.viewport: A project's runs as side A and side B.
options.case: Fuses poorly: handwriting and a two-sided card do not fit a multi-line floor.
options.kept: Every item carries its running time against a budget it must not overflow.

options.label: Garden Guide Map
options.thesis: Swelling lobes of flat colour divided by coastline.
options.viewport: Each project a lobe of land.
options.case: Fuses poorly: lobes and overshooting motion cost clarity on a monitoring screen.
options.risk: Playful where the operator needs certainty.
options.kept: Flat, fully committed colour fields with no gradient or grain.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A dark operations dashboard as the best tools in the category ship it, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Side navigation, a row of totals, a table of lines and runs with status pills, an inbox panel.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
